title: Men's Christmas – Attending Under Protest Embroidered Zip Hoodie

seo.title: Christmas Zip Up Hoodie – Attending Under Protest
seo.description: A christmas zip up hoodie: ATTENDING UNDER PROTEST on the back under a stern cross-stitch reindeer in a Santa hat, plus stitched UNDER PROTEST lettering on the chest.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

This christmas zip up hoodie is for the dad who will be at every holiday party and would like it on record that he did not want to go, zipped on for the family dinner and the long couch afterwards.

A stern cross-stitch reindeer in a Santa hat stands with its hooves crossed over a red and cream knit sweater, snowflakes around it, in red, cream, sage and black with a stitched knit texture. ATTENDING and UNDER PROTEST sit below it in three huge lines of tall collegiate slab capitals: cream on Black and Navy, navy on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small UNDER over PROTEST wordmark in the same slab capitals as the back is embroidered on the left chest, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest UNDER PROTEST wordmark, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the Attending Under Protest zip hoodie fit?
The Attending Under Protest christmas zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this christmas hoodie warm enough for drafty holiday dinners?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles drafty holiday dinners, cold porch steps and the drive home from the party well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, the cross-stitch reindeer above ATTENDING UNDER PROTEST, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small UNDER over PROTEST wordmark in the same slab capitals as the back sits on the left chest.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The UNDER PROTEST wordmark on the chest is stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for a grumpy dad, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the dad who shows up to every holiday party and complains the whole way there. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
